posts.title: This Week in Texas Athletics: Football gets ready for the Lone Star Showdown, men’s basketball prepares for difficult non-conference stretch
posts.description: Editor’s Note: A previous version of the description misspelled Senior Sports Reporter Ylver Deleon-Rios’ name and incorrectly identified Deleon-Rios and Senior Sports Reporter Leo Barnes’ titles. Their names and titles have since been corrected. The Texan regrets this error. “ This Week in Texas Athletics” is a sports podcast featuring reporters from The Daily Texan’s sports department, going beyond the box scores to discuss the latest in Texas Athletics. In this week’s episode, Sports Desk Editor Payton Blalock and Senior Sports Reporters Ylver Deleon-Rios and Leo Barnes, who cover men’s basketball, join the podcast to talk about Texas football’s upcoming rivalry game at Texas A&M, men’s basketball’s victory over Baylor and their upcoming stretch of tough non-conference opponents. Narrated and edited by Jackson Bauer. Cover photo by Ysa Mendoza. Music by Indie Box from bensound.com. posts.title: People of UT: David Ryfe
posts.description: General Audio Staffers Chloe Epshtein and Britta Baros speak with David Ryfe, director of and professor in the School of Journalism and Media, about his personal and career stories, advice to college students and where he thinks the future of journalism is headed. Narrated and edited by Chloe Epshtein and Britta Baros. Cover photo by Ria Nam. Music by Blue Dot Sessions. [Intro music] Advertisement Epshtein: Welcome to People of UT. My name is Chloe Epshtein and I am a general audio reporter for The Daily Texan. Baros: And my name is Britta Baros and I am also a general audio reporter for The Daily Texan. In this episode of People of UT, we spoke with Director of and professor in the School of Journalism and Media, David Ryfe, about his personal story, his advice to students and where he thinks the future of journalism might be headed.
